name: cipher-mux-electron
description: Electron-basierte Kommandozentrale für Claude Code Projekte

scripts.dev: BUILD_PROFILE=cipher concurrently "npm run dev:main" "npm run dev:renderer"
scripts.version:generate: echo "// src/shared/version.ts — Auto-generated by scripts/git-version.sh\n// Do not edit manually.\nexport const APP_VERSION = '$(./scripts/git-version.sh)';" > src/shared/version.ts
scripts.build: npm run version:generate && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.dist: npm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dmg
scripts.test: npm run rebuild:node && node --test --import tsx $(find test -name '*.test.ts' | sort)
scripts.rebuild:voice: npx electron-rebuild -f -w @fugood/whisper.node sherpa-onnx-node 2>/dev/null; echo 'Voice native modules rebuilt for Electron ABI'

author: cipher
